item.title: American Caper #5 (Simon Bisley Variant Cover) :: Profile :: Dark Horse Comics
item.description: Brides and Butchery!William Hamilton dodges a bullet. Literally. Eliza Charmers discovers a murder weapon. Nearly. Eva and Maria run into some very familiar “friends.”Meanwhile: Marnie and her conspiracy crush meet up at a gun range. And Eva reveals a dark secret of her former life in Mexico amongst the cartels as a glamour model.New comic book series from the head writer and creative team of Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption!Ongoing series.

item.title: Leonide the Vampyr: The House of Yonda #1 (Mike Mignola Variant Cover) :: Profile :: Dark Horse Comics
item.description: After the vampire girl is chased off by the townspeople, she is found unresponsive and whisked away by wagon to a doctor. But when the wagon arrives, the drivers are mummified and the girl is missing, with only a seed left in her place.Leonide the Vampyr returns in this two-part story from Mike Mignola and Rachele Aragno that will follow the search for the missing girl to her ancestral home—and expose her horrifying heritage.Leonide the Vampyr continues in this new, two-part story!

item.description: A value-priced collection of three standalone comics stories following Geralt’s journey through new and familiar lands.
